activities.name: Job Center
activities.blurb: Choose a career, play its skill game and earn a real paycheck (with taxes in Advanced). Good shifts lead to promotions.
activities.entryBlurb: Pick a job and do your best to earn money!

activities.name: Salary Negotiation
activities.blurb: You got a job offer! Research the market, know your walk-away number, and negotiate, without losing the offer.
activities.entryBlurb: Practice asking for fair pay in a friendly way.

activities.name: Stock Options Desk
activities.blurb: Compare salary vs. stock options: strike price, vesting schedules, cliffs and what options are worth if the company does well, or doesn't.
activities.entryBlurb: Learn what it means to own a tiny piece of the company you work for.

activities.name: Freelance Puzzles
activities.blurb: Program a delivery robot to collect coins. Fewer commands = more freelance pay.
activities.entryBlurb: Give the robot directions to grab the coins!

activities.name: Sorting Conveyor
activities.blurb: Sort each item: need, want, or does it depend on the situation?
activities.entryBlurb: Is it a NEED or a WANT? Sort them all!

activities.name: My First Paycheck
activities.blurb: A story about planning your very first paycheck.

activities.name: Scam Detector
activities.blurb: Emails, texts and websites: decide SAFE or SCAM and tap the red flags.
activities.entryBlurb: Is this message safe or a trick? Find the clues!

activities.name: Password Strength Lab
activities.blurb: Rank passwords from weakest to strongest and learn why length beats complexity.

activities.name: File a Tax Return
activities.blurb: Fill in an FC-1040: income, standard vs. itemized deduction, taxable income, bracket tax, credits, and refund or amount owed. Uses your real W-2 when you have one.
activities.entryBlurb: A story about why everyone pays taxes.

activities.name: Paycheck Decoder
activities.blurb: Read real-looking pay stubs: find gross, net, FICA and the effective tax rate, and spot the payroll mistake.

activities.name: Career Quiz
activities.blurb: Questions about jobs, paychecks, taxes and staying safe online.
